title: Feelings and descriptions
focus: Reading adjectives and feelings: 高兴 开心 累 忙 饿 漂亮 好看 贵 便宜 难 容易 有意思 舒服.
body:
# Feelings and descriptions

These are the words you use to say how you feel and what things are like. Many feelings carry 心 or 忄 (heart), and many descriptions of money carry 贝 (shell, the old currency). Notice them and you can often guess the meaning before you can say the word.

| Word | Pinyin | Clue in the character |
|---|---|---|
| 高兴 开心 | gāoxìng kāixīn | happy; 开心 = 'open heart' |
| 忙 怕 | máng pà | 忄 heart on the left |
| 饿 | è | 饣 food on the left |
| 贵 | guì | 贝 money at the bottom |
| 累 难 | lèi nán | tired, difficult |
| 漂亮 好看 可爱 帅 | piàoliang hǎokàn kě'ài shuài | pretty, good-looking, cute, handsome |
| 冷 热 | lěng rè | 冫 ice / 灬 fire |
| 舒服 有意思 | shūfu yǒu yìsi | comfortable, interesting |

## Examples

- 见到你很高兴。 jiàndào nǐ hěn gāoxìng: Nice to see you.
- 你累不累? nǐ lèi bu lèi: Are you tired?
- 你最近忙吗? nǐ zuìjìn máng ma: Have you been busy lately?
- 我饿死了。 wǒ è sǐ le: I'm starving.
- 太贵了,便宜一点吧。 tài guì le, piányi yìdiǎn ba: Too expensive, make it a bit cheaper.
- 中文字好难。 Zhōngwén zì hǎo nán: Chinese characters are so hard.
- 说话容易,写字难。 shuōhuà róngyì, xiě zì nán: Speaking is easy, writing is hard.
- 这本书很有意思。 zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi: This book is really interesting.
- 我不太舒服。 wǒ bú tài shūfu: I don't feel very well.
- 别着急,慢慢来。 bié zháojí, mànmàn lái: Don't rush, take your time.
- 今天太热了。 jīntiān tài rè le: It's so hot today.

## Common mistakes

- **帅 vs 师.** 帅 (shuài, handsome) and 师 (shī, teacher, as in 老师) differ by one stroke: 师 has an extra horizontal line on top.
- **Characters with two readings.** 便宜 is piányi, but 便 is biàn in 方便. 着急 is zháojí, not zhe.
- **冫 vs 氵.** In 冷 and 冰, two dots (冫) mean ice or cold; three dots (氵) mean water.

cards.Example: 见到你很高兴。 jiàndào nǐ hěn gāoxìng: Nice to see you.
cards.Notes: 兴 is xìng here; 高 = tall

cards.Example: 今天玩得很开心。 jīntiān wán de hěn kāixīn: I had a great time today.
cards.Notes: Literally 'open heart'; 开 vs 井 (jǐng, well)

cards.Example: 你累不累? nǐ lèi bu lèi: Are you tired?
cards.Notes: 田 + 糸 silk

cards.Example: 你最近忙吗? nǐ zuìjìn máng ma: Have you been busy lately?
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 亡 wáng for the sound

cards.Example: 我饿死了。 wǒ è sǐ le: I'm starving.
cards.Notes: 饣 food + 我 wǒ

cards.Example: 她今天真漂亮。 tā jīntiān zhēn piàoliang: She looks really pretty today.
cards.Notes: 漂 = 氵 + 票 piào for the sound

cards.Example: 这部电影很好看。 zhè bù diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn: This film is really good.
cards.Notes: 看 = 手 hand over 目 eye

cards.Example: 太贵了! tài guì le: Too expensive!
cards.Notes: 贝 shell (old money) at the bottom

cards.Example: 这个很便宜。 zhège hěn piányi: This one's cheap.
cards.Notes: 便 is pián here, but biàn in 方便

cards.Example: 中文字好难。 Zhōngwén zì hǎo nán: Chinese characters are so hard.
cards.Notes: 又 + 隹; same sound as 男 (nán, male)

cards.Example: 说话容易,写字难。 shuōhuà róngyì, xiě zì nán: Speaking is easy, writing is hard.
cards.Notes: 容 has 宀 roof; 易 = 日 + 勿

cards.Example: 这本书很有意思。 zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi: This book is really interesting.
cards.Notes: 意 and 思 both have 心 heart at the bottom

cards.Example: 这个沙发很舒服。 zhège shāfā hěn shūfu: This sofa is really comfy.
cards.Notes: 服 is neutral-tone fu here

cards.Example: 别难过了。 bié nánguò le: Don't be sad.
cards.Notes: Literally 'hard to get through'; 过 has 辶 walk

cards.Example: 你生气了吗? nǐ shēngqì le ma: Are you angry?
cards.Notes: Literally 'produce air'; 气 = air

cards.Example: 我有点害怕。 wǒ yǒudiǎn hàipà: I'm a bit scared.
cards.Notes: 怕 = 忄 heart + 白 bái

cards.Example: 别着急,慢慢来。 bié zháojí, mànmàn lái: Don't rush, take your time.
cards.Notes: 着 is zháo here, not the particle zhe

cards.Example: 好无聊啊。 hǎo wúliáo a: So bored.
cards.Notes: 无 = without; 聊 as in 聊天

cards.Example: 今天太热了。 jīntiān tài rè le: It's so hot today.
cards.Notes: 灬 fire dots at the bottom

cards.Example: 外面很冷。 wàimiàn hěn lěng: It's cold outside.
cards.Notes: 冫 two dots = ice; 氵 three dots = water

cards.Example: 我最近胖了。 wǒ zuìjìn pàng le: I've put on weight lately.
cards.Notes: 月 (flesh) + 半 bàn

cards.Example: 你瘦了! nǐ shòu le: You've lost weight!
cards.Notes: 疒 sickness radical on the outside

cards.Example: 这个小孩好可爱。 zhège xiǎohái hǎo kě'ài: This kid is so cute.
cards.Notes: 爱 has 友 at the bottom; traditional 愛 has 心

cards.Example: 他好帅啊! tā hǎo shuài a: He's so handsome!
cards.Notes: 师 (shī, teacher) has one more stroke on top

cards.Example: 房间很干净。 fángjiān hěn gānjìng: The room is very clean.
cards.Notes: 净 = 冫 + 争 zhēng

cards.Example: 请安静。 qǐng ānjìng: Quiet, please.
cards.Notes: 静 = 青 qīng + 争; 青 gives the sound
不 is bú before the 4th-tone 太

cards.Pinyin: tài guì le, piányi yìdiǎn ba
cards.Meaning: Too expensive, make it a bit cheaper.
cards.Notes: 一 is yì before the 3rd-tone 点
看起来 = looks like; 起 has 走 walk
